Dogecoin fans thrilled by @elonmusk's "D.O.G.E." tweet.

Elon Musk posted a cryptic tweet simply stating "D.O.G.E." 

Prior to this, he shared an official document about his appointment as the Head of the Department of Government Efficiency (D.O.G.E.).

MyDoge prepares for DogeOS launch.

The CEO of MyDoge announced the upcoming launch of DogeOS, a platform for creating games and applications, which has increased interest in Dogecoin within the Web3 community.  

The launch of DogeOS could support DOGE’s growth, which has risen https://t.co/WFKHgSWNrn

@dogecoin whales accumulated 140 million DOGE.

Large investors purchased approximately $55 million worth of DOGE in the past 24 hours.  

This accumulation has led to a noticeable increase in DOGE trading volume. 

Some analysts have even suggested that DOGE could reach a target https://t.co/scpWWw4tlQ

@SECGov delays ETF decision again.

Decisions have been postponed for ETFs based on XRP, @Solana, @Litecoin and @Dogecoin.

The commission has 240 days to make a decision, but the SEC is clearly in no hurry.
